title: Perceive, Interact, Reason: Building Tool-Augmented Visual Agents for Spatial Reasoning
title_zh: 感知、交互、推理：构建用于空间推理的工具增强视觉智能体
abstract_en: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate strong multimodal understanding, they remain limited in spatial reasoning tasks that require active evidence acquisition and multi-step visual interaction. This limitation suggests that relying solely on implicit visual representations from vision encoders is insufficient for recovering fine-grained spatial evidence. We introduce PERception-Interaction-reason Agent (PERIA), a tool-augmented visual agent for spatial reasoning tasks across map reasoning, visual probing, and vision reconstruction. PERIA uses two lightweight tool families: vision perception tools for exposing textual, symbolic, and spatial evidence, and vision interaction tools for manipulating visual context, tracing paths, and verifying spatial relations. To train PERIA, we develop a unified recipe that combines supervised tool-use trajectory synthesis, composite rewards, and Observation-Relaxed Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (OR-GIGPO) for effective multi-tool behavior. Experiments on 13 benchmarks from 8 datasets show that PERIA-8B improves over the Qwen3-8B backbone by 10.0% on in-distribution benchmarks and 4.4% on out-of-distribution benchmarks, while outperforming previous state-of-the-art baselines of similar size by 7.0%-14.8%. It also achieves performance comparable to much larger models such as Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking and GPT-5, demonstrating the effectiveness of PERIA in enhancing spatial reasoning capabilities.
abstract_zh: 近期 vision-language models（VLMs）虽具备较强的多模态理解能力，但在需要主动获取证据和多步视觉交互的空间推理任务中仍存在明显局限，说明仅依赖视觉编码器的隐式视觉表征不足以恢复细粒度空间证据。本文提出 PERception-Interaction-reason Agent（PERIA），一种面向地图推理、视觉探测和视觉重建等空间推理任务的工具增强视觉智能体。PERIA 使用两类轻量工具：vision perception tools 用于显式提取文本、符号和空间证据；vision interaction tools 用于操作视觉上下文、追踪路径并验证空间关系。为训练 PERIA，作者设计了统一训练方案，结合监督式工具使用轨迹合成、复合奖励，以及 Observation-Relaxed Group-in-Group Policy Optimization（OR-GIGPO），以学习有效的多工具行为。在来自 8 个数据集的 13 个 benchmark 上，PERIA-8B 相比 Qwen3-8B backbone 在分布内任务提升 10.0%，在分布外任务提升 4.4%，并比同等规模的先前 SOTA baseline 高 7.0%–14.8%。其性能还可接近 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking 和 GPT-5 等更大模型，表明 PERIA 能有效增强空间推理能力。
key_points_zh: 提出 PERIA：面向空间推理的工具增强视觉智能体，覆盖 map reasoning、visual probing 和 vision reconstruction 等任务。
核心思想是弥补 VLM 隐式视觉表征不足，通过工具主动获取细粒度空间证据，而非仅依赖视觉编码器一次性理解图像。
设计两类轻量工具：vision perception tools 提取文本、符号、空间信息；vision interaction tools 支持视觉上下文操作、路径追踪和空间关系验证。
训练方案结合监督式工具轨迹合成、复合奖励和 OR-GIGPO，提升多工具调用与多步推理能力。
在 13 个 benchmark 上，PERIA-8B 显著优于 Qwen3-8B 和同规模 SOTA，并接近 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking、GPT-5 等大模型表现。

llm_assessment.comment: PERIA is a solid tool-augmented VLM training recipe for spatial reasoning, but its contributions appear mostly incremental over existing visual-agent frameworks.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: PERIA是面向空间推理的扎实工具增强视觉语言模型训练方案，但相较现有视觉代理框架主要属于增量改进。
